'''Cheese and crackers''' are a simple snack.

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]]
* [[Cookbook:cracker|Crackers]]

==Procedure==
# Get out a [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|cutting board]].
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] cheese into pieces small enough to fit on a cracker.
# Place cheese on a cracker (or spread with a knife if using cream cheese).
# Top cheese with another cracker if you would like.
